items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability, dubbed 'StyleSmuggler' by Sansec, allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations. Adobe released an emergency hotfix, and is aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying this update in addition to the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. One critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-71362) was reported to be under attempted exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that could be leveraged by an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. Indications emerged that threat actors were attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves important and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution. Amasty released a fix in version 4.0.0, and attacks were observed the same day the patch shipped.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.
